raw: #12 Low: `cargo fmt --check` will fail CI. Issue: `.github/workflows/ci-rust.yml:454` runs `cargo fmt -- --check`. Two new hunks violate default rustfmt: `mod.rs:218` is a 117-character *code* line (rustfmt's `max_width` is 100 and it will wrap the `if` condition), and `billing.rs:96-97` introduces two consecutive blank lines before `#[cfg(test)]` (default `blank_lines_upper_bound = 1`). Line lengths measured with `awk 'length > 100'`. `cargo` is not installed in this environment, so this was not confirmed by running the check. Fix: run `cargo fmt` over the crate.

raw: Considered But Not Flagged (solo-reviewer): `posthog/api/feature_flag.py:3521` - [false] Suspected that `model_to_dict` omits the auto pk, which would make every override fail to deserialize into Rust's `FeatureFlag` (whose `id` has no `#[serde(default)]`) and silently fall back to the live flag.
